exceptions.delta-mp/pages-cs/dashboard/index.vue: Unregistered legacy staff dashboard. No customer-facing route; remove its private skeleton before re-registering.

navigation.forward: Reveal the incoming content once. Do not wait for a leave animation.
navigation.return: Restore list position, focus and drafts; do not run a second native slide.
navigation.sameView: Filtering, paging, polling and retry do not remount the route.
navigation.redirect: Animate the final destination, not the intermediate guard.
navigation.reduced: Static content and accessible status; no movement or looping shimmer.

feedback.initial: Delay visible busy feedback; use one region with the final layout footprint.
feedback.refresh: Keep existing content and show refresh status at the initiating control.
feedback.append: Keep all loaded rows. Show status or retry at the list tail.
feedback.submit: Indicate pending at the action. Prevent duplicate business submissions independently of animation.
feedback.error: Retain previous data where available. Never substitute an empty state for failure.
feedback.external: Only our handoff and return pages are controlled; do not consume tickets, restart payment or delay an external gesture.
